partners.mechanism_chain: SMN1 (HGNC:11160) —DISRUPTS→ Ribosome assembly (GO:0000255); Ribosome assembly (GO:0000255) —LEADS_TO→ Motor neuron degeneration (HP:0002395); RPS26 (HGNC:10460) —DISRUPTS→ Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254); Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254) —LEADS_TO→ Anemia (HP:0001874); Ribosome assembly (GO:0000255) —LEADS_TO→ Protein synthesis (GO:0006412); Ribosome biogenesis (GO:0042254) —LEADS_TO→ Protein synthesis (GO:0006412). Loss-of-function mutations in SMN1 disrupt ribosome assembly (n2), ultimately leading to motor neuron degeneration (n3) in SMA. Similarly, loss-of-function mutations in RPS26 disrupt ribosome biogenesis (n5), causing anemia (n6) in DBA. falsification.text: The identification of a pathogenic variant in RPS26 in patients diagnosed with SMA type IV, or conversely, a pathogenic variant in SMN1 in patients diagnosed with DBA, would falsify this hypothesis of distinct causal genes converging on a shared pathway.
